During a trip, Bill drove his car for 14.0 miles and then began driving at a constant speed of 70.0
miles per hour. After 2 hours of driving at this speed, what is the total distance, in miles, Bill has
traveled during this trip?

For a project, Kayla recorded the heights of 21 people in her neighborhood. The histogram
summarizes the heights, in inches (in), of these 21 people in Kayla’$s$ neighborhood. The first bar
represents people with a height of at least 51 in but less than 53 in. The second bar represents
people with a height of at least 53 in but less than 55 in, and so on.

How many of these 21 people in Kayla’$s$ neighborhood had a height of at least 51 in but less than
55 in?

$$h(t)=-16t2+b$$
The function $h$ estimates an object’$s$ height, in feet, above the ground $t$ seconds after the object is
dropped, where $b$ is a constant. The function estimates that the object is 6.76 feet above the
ground when it is dropped at $t=0$. How many seconds after being dropped does the function
estimate the object will hit the ground?

The function $g$ is defined by $g ( x )=( x+18 ) ( t - x )$, where $t$ is a constant. In the $xy$-
plane, the graph of $y=g ( x )$ passes through the point $(22,0)$. What is the value of $g ( 0 )$?

The equation $54=2 x+2 y$ gives the perimeter of a rectangular garden that has length $x$, in
feet, and width $y$, in feet. The width of the garden is 12 feet. What is the length, in feet, of the
garden?

A car dealership has only sedans, SUVs, and minivans for sale. On Monday, $30\%$ of the vehicles
for sale were sedans and $50\%$ were SUVs. If there were 18 sedans for sale at the dealership on
Monday, how many minivans were for sale?
